jobs.title: Producer / Project Manager Marketing Agency
jobs.jd_full:
Column Five is seeking a part-time transition to full-time eventually mid-level Producer to service our accounts. Column Five is a strategic creative agency that helps ambitious brands find and tell their best stories to drive real results.

Producers are liaisons to a dedicated list of clients, they are both project managers and creatives. Producers work directly with our 100% remote team and our clients to produce and deliver digital marketing content. Producers share the responsibility for the overall quality of our work and whether it supports the strategic objectives for a client. The producer position reports to the Director of Production.

As a Producer at Column Five, you’ll work with a vibrant team in a fast-paced and remote work environment built on collaboration, camaraderie, freedom, and flexibility. Each day you’ll find surprising challenges that stretch your skills and expand your creativity. We value responsibility and autonomy, so we’ve designed our tools and processes to help you do your best work. Most importantly, you’ll get the chance to grow with talented people who make you feel loved, respected, and welcomed.

PRODUCER RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES

  • Manage and communicate scope, timelines, budgets and objectives in our project management software, ClickUp
  • Lead and manage communication and relationship growth with our clients and all team members (including contractors)
  • Design and lead creative brainstorm and ideation sessions for internal project teams
  • Present ideas to clients, participate in pitching concepts and generating strategies for account growth
  • Curiosity about the work, the client, the market, and how to make everything 10% better

PRODUCER REQUIREMENTS

  • Project Management
    • Advanced skills, experience prioritizing a varied workload and proficiency with one project management tool like ClickUp, Asana, Jira or similar
    • Experience creating and managing a content calendar or schedules for multiple digital creative projects at once
    • Experience leveraging quarterly account budgets to meet strategic goals
  • Client Service
    • Deliver great client experience at all levels of our clients’ organizations using adaptive and strategic communication, including strong presentation and negotiation skills
  • Leadership
    • Be a proactive contributor to the team and our business
    • Refine and grow others’ ideas and team performance by regularly articulating constructive criticisms during team ideation, retrospectives and peer feedback
    • Stay abreast of industry trends and find ways to incorporate into projects and share knowledge and trends with other members of C5
    • Humility to listen, grow, and learn

JOB PERKS

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience
  • A fun, engaged, and inclusive team
  • Full time benefits for USA employees:
    • Full health insurance + dependent health insurance
    • Profit Sharing
    • Parental leave
    • Trainings, education, and investment to support career growth
    • FSA plan (medical and dependent care)
    • Life insurance, long-term & short-term disability insurance
    • Remote-first company in USA
    • Generous 401(k) savings plan

COMPENSATION

Compensation is dependent upon experience and the need to the business. The current opening is for a part-time, hourly employee with a pay range of $40 - $50/hour.

LOCATION

We are a distributed- or remote-first company. This means that we are open to working with you if you live anywhere within the USA.

We are only interested in USA candidates at this time.

HOW TO APPLY

Please applywith a current resume, and a cover letter that includes why you are the right person for Column Five. Please note the compensation rates above.

No phone calls, please. Although we value the services recruitment agencies provide, at this time we are not leveraging external 3rd party recruitment resources for this search. Should those needs change, we will seek your assistance directly.

Column Five is an Equal Opportunity Employer focused on creating a workplace of belonging. We encourage applicants from all walks of life and do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, and other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you need reasonable accommodations for any part of the employment process, let us know.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Discovery Experience
jobs.jd_full:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About CookUnity

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager, Discovery Experience to own the consumer-facing surfaces that connect eaters with the meals they’ll love.

This is the most-trafficked real estate in the product. From the moment a subscriber opens the app to the moment they complete their order, every screen they touch — the home screen, search, menu, collections, product detail pages, and cart — falls within this role’s remit. You’ll own the product vision, roadmap, and execution across all of it.

You’ll work closely with Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Merchandising to make the discovery experience feel effortless, personal, and exciting.

What You’ll Do

Own the Discovery Surface End-to-End

  • Set and drive the product vision and roadmap across Home Screen, Search, Menu, Swimlanes, Collections, Product Tile & Detail, Cart & Checkout, and Core UI Components.
  • Define a coherent discovery experience across web and mobile that scales with catalog complexity and evolving user needs.
  • Manage a large, diverse surface area with competing priorities without losing coherence or momentum.

Ship High-Impact Consumer Features

  • Partner with Engineering and Design to build, iterate, and launch features that meaningfully improve how eaters find and choose meals.
  • Own the product layer of CookUnity’s server-driven UI (SDUI) system — thinking critically about how the component architecture enables flexibility for merchandisers while maintaining a great eater experience.
  • Drive experimentation across discovery surfaces with rigorous metric frameworks.

Elevate the UX

  • Partner tightly with Design to create discovery experiences that reduce friction, build confidence, and feel intuitive across every entry point.
  • Own the quality and consistency of core UI components (loading states, error screens, coachmarks, modals) as a shared foundation across the product.
  • Maintain a high bar for mobile and web parity, while allowing for platform-native patterns where they matter.

Navigate the Frontend/Intelligence Seam

  • Work as a close counterpart to the Sr. PM, Personalization & AI — jointly owning decisions that live at the intersection of how surfaces are designed and what intelligence powers them.
  • Translate what the personalization and AI systems are capable of into frontend experiences that make that intelligence visible and useful to eaters.
  • Bring a clear point of view to surface-level decisions even when the upstream inputs are probabilistic, evolving, or contested.

Drive Measurable Business Impact

  • Improve conversion across browse surfaces (home, search, swimlanes, collections, full menu).
  • Reduce checkout abandonment and cart-to-order friction.
  • Lift overall funnel CVR and contribution to weekly order frequency and reduction of subscriber churn.

You Are

  • A senior, frontend-first product thinker with deep instincts for consumer UX and a track record of owning high-traffic discovery or browsing surfaces.
  • Comfortable holding a wide, complex surface area — you can zoom out to set coherent strategy across many screens while staying close enough to the details to make good product decisions.
  • A strong design partner who can elevate the quality of an experience, not just spec it.
  • Technically grounded enough to work fluently with frontend engineers, understand component architecture, and reason about how system-level decisions affect the user experience.
  • Genuinely excited by the challenge of making a large, dynamic food catalog feel simple and delightful to browse.
  • Collaborative and low-ego at the seam between your work and adjacent PM domains; you know how to maintain shared ownership without losing accountability.
  • Rigorous about experimentation and metrics without being paralyzed by them.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including meaningful ownership of consumer-facing mobile and/or web surfaces at scale.
  • Demonstrated experience with discovery, browsing, search, or shopping experiences, ideally in a marketplace or catalog-heavy product.
  • Strong UX instincts and a proven track record of close collaboration with design teams.
  • Comfortable with frontend product systems (component libraries, server-driven UI, feature flags) and able to partner effectively with frontend engineers.
  • Experience running A/B experiments, defining metrics, and making data-informed decisions in ambiguous situations.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication; able to influence design, engineering, and business stakeholders across a complex organization.
  • Proven ability to manage a large roadmap across multiple surfaces simultaneously.

Learn More About CookUnity

We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. To give you deeper insight into who we are and what we’re looking for, we invite you to explore: CookUnity’s Leadership Principles – The values and behaviors that guide how we operate, collaborate, and scale.

We hope this provides valuable insight into our culture and product vision. If this excites you, we’d love to connect!

Benefits

💸 Get paid in USD

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want

⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date

🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical

🐣 Paid Family leave

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises

🧘🏽‍♀️ Customize the benefits that suit your needs! Access a range of perks tailored to you, including learning opportunities, wellness memberships, delivery apps, and more through our comprehensive benefit platform

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we’ll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates

We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

  • Apply only through our official channels.All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com
  • Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify.You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.
  • We only communicate through official CookUnity channels.That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.
  • We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details.If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

jobs.title: Event Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Meeting Tomorrow is a 23-year-old company with a growing team of 90 talented, friendly people. We’re headquartered in Chicago, with about 80% of our team working remotely in cities across the country.

We are a full-service event agency with three core divisions: planning, production, and creative. We plan and produce corporate events of every shape and size, partnering with clients that include Fortune 500 companies and leading organizations across a wide array of industries.

We’re known for our exceptional customer experience, our collaborative culture, and our can-do spirit. Our culture has earned us recognition as a Top 20 Inspiring Workplace in North America, as well as the Events Industry Council’s Social Impact Award. We offer great benefits, the best coworkers you’ll find anywhere, and the opportunity to work in a dynamic, team-oriented environment. We can’t wait to meet you!

The Opportunity

The Event Project Manager is responsible for managing the complex lifecycle of AV production and creative design projects for our clients’ most important events.

This person will work with clients across the Tech, Finance, Pharma, and Non-Profit spaces, serving as the face of Meeting Tomorrow throughout the event execution process. You aren’t just managing tasks; you are a consultant and a brand steward for our clients’ most vital internal and client-facing events, leading the information flow across all parties. This role is highly detailed, task-oriented, and requires the executive presence to guide stakeholders throughout the whole process, ultimately ensuring the clients’ vision for AV production and creative design becomes reality.

This role requires frequent to moderate onsite travel (approximately 20-30%, or 4-5 days per month).

What You’ll Own

  • Audiovisual Event Project Planning: You’ll lead numerous events throughout the year, managing project scope, timelines, and budgets. You’ll guide clients through the project lifecycle, coaching them on AV Production best practices for in-person and hybrid events to ensure the execution exceeds their vision.
  • Communication & Decision Making: You are the client’s main point of contact and MT representative. You’ll lead the information flow between internal teams (fulfillment, creative, etc.), venues, vendors, and the client, while expertly preparing onsite staff for successful execution.
  • Client Relationship Building: You don’t just manage events but you build genuine connections. You’ll get to know our clients on a personal level (interests, family, life events) and bring a level of enthusiasm that drives credibility and repeat business.
  • Creative Deliverables Management: You’ll act as the bridge between clients and creative teams (designers, editors). You’ll manage logistics with vendors (decor, print, custom fabrication), maintain asset trackers, manage POs, and negotiate terms to be a true steward of the client’s budget.
  • On-Site Leadership: You’ll travel (approx. 20-30%) to be the face of MT, preparing onsite staff in partnership with Production Managers to execute flawlessly while maintaining high energy in fast-paced event environments.

What We Need

  • 4-7+ Years of Event Industry Experience: You’ve navigated the agency or white-glove event world and have a customer-focused mindset.
  • Organization & Speed: You’re a fast-paced multitasker who is accountable to deadlines and finds joy in the details.
  • Great Communicator. You’re able to communicate clearly and effectively both verbally and in writing.
  • People person. You’re able to build relationships and cater your approach depending on the person you’re talking to. You’re experienced in working with different personalities and professional levels.
  • Technical & Creative Curiosity: You’re ready to dive into AV production and creative service logistics.
  • Adaptability. You can confidently work and make decisions in gray, unpredictable spaces with shifting priorities. When faced with unforeseen challenges, you adjust to keep the project (and everybody) on track.
  • Values Alignment: You demonstrate kindness, commitment, and humility in everything you do.

The Impact

Within 1 month, you’ll:

  • Learn about MT’s services - the value we offer, the types of events that we service and our customer-service mentality.

Have opportunities for training to expand your exposure and understanding of how we manage events at Meeting Tomorrow

  • Meet with current members of the Project Management, Production, Creative, and Sales teams to understand best practices for supporting our clients and their diverse needs.

Within 3 months, you’ll:

  • Build strong and lasting relationships with clients and internal team members, ensuring a strong client retention rate.
  • Begin to create your own processes for working with your clients and identify opportunities for efficiency/improvement.
  • Become proficient in our CRM, Netsuite and Project Planning tool, Backstage.
  • Work with members of our internal support teams to effectively manage a large-scale event or event series for premier clients. These clients include Fortune-5000 companies in many sectors including pharmaceutical, wealth management, and production service agencies.

Within 6 months you’ll:

  • Have proficiency in the role and be managing accounts with autonomy.
  • Complete projects to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the team.
  • Demonstrate an aptitude for problem solving and contingency planning; striving to consistently exceed client expectations.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision plan options
  • Employer paid STD, LTD, Life Insurance, and EAP access
  • 401k with employer matching up to 4%
  • 16 PTO days (increases with tenure) + 9 paid holidays
  • Annual profit-sharing bonus
  • 12 weeks 100% paid parental leave (maternity, paternity, adoption)
  • $50 Monthly fitness reimbursement
  • Monthly stipends for internet and/or cell
  • Company donation(s) to your charities of choice (up to $1,000 annually)
  • Regular social events and learning opportunities

$75,286 - $94,107 a year

The above range is the starting salary range for this role. The final starting salary is based on individual experience and how closely it translates to the role. Once in the role, we offer annual merit increases based on performance.

At Meeting Tomorrow, our mission is to foster a culture of respect and affection. We embrace our differences and are committed to having a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer that believes in second chances and strongly encourages BIPOC, women, LGBTQIA, veterans, persons with disabilities, formerly incarcerated and all other individuals to apply.

What makes Meeting Tomorrow’s culture so special is the people, and we look for candidates who are a match for our company’s core values: commitment, kindness and humility. If those words describe you and you see yourself in this posting, you’re ready to apply!

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Data Society Group

At Data Society Group, we provide the highest quality, leading-edge, industry-tailored data and AI training and solutions for Fortune 1,000 companies and federal, state, and local governmental organizations. We partner with our clients to educate, equip, and empower their workforces with the skills they need to achieve their goals and expand their impact. Our portfolio of brands and services sits at the intersection of people, data, and AI and consists of:

  • CDO Magazine, the trusted voice of global data and AI leadership
  • The Data Lodge, a pioneer in data literacy and cultural transformation
  • Data Society, delivering applied AI education and custom-built solutions
  • InspiredMinds!, a convening force behind the world’s most inclusive AI community

We are working to empower the workforces of the future; if you’re as passionate about transforming workplaces with the power of Data & AI as we are, we’d love to hear from you!

About the Role

The Project Manager is responsible for the day-to-day delivery management of a complex, multi-workstream enterprise software implementation. This role runs the full delivery team—both onshore and offshore—ensuring sprint cadence, risk management, stakeholder communication, and delivery governance operate smoothly across all phases.

Working under the direction of the Program Manager, the Project Manager serves as the operational hub of the engagement. You will own the program plan, track issues and risks, coordinate with the technology implementation team on dependencies, and contribute to both internal and client-facing status reporting.

This role is work-from-home (remote) though must be able to commute to client offices in Falls Church, VA as needed (estimated every 2 weeks). This is a full-time W2 employment position with benefits. Please note that this role is tied to a client contract and is structured as an initial 9-month position. Opportunities for extension or long-term placement are highly likely based on client renewal and project performance.

Responsibilities

As the Project Manager, you will lead daily execution, drive cross-functional alignment, and enforce project governance. Your primary duties include:

  • Delivery Team & Schedule Management: Own day-to-day project tracking across all workstreams, maintaining the program plan, monitoring milestones, and flagging risks or schedule variances to the Program Manager. Direct onshore and offshore team members across all workstreams to ensure clarity on priorities, blockers, and deliverables.
  • Risk Management & Governance: Capture, track, and drive resolution for all risks and issues via the risk and issue log. Enforce the RACI matrix and governance cadence to ensure decision-making and escalation paths are followed and documented.
  • Sprint Operations & Team Coordination: Facilitate sprint planning and retrospective logistics, track velocity, and maintain backlog hygiene in the project management tool. Coordinate with offshore team leads on capacity, blockers, and status, escalating to the Program Manager when necessary.
  • Technology Implementation Alignment: Coordinate directly with the technology implementation team on project-related topics, dependencies, and integration touchpoints, escalating program-level decisions as needed.
  • Reporting & Documentation: Draft content for client-facing and internal status reports for Program Manager review. Maintain all program documentation—including meeting notes, decision logs, and delivery artifacts—ensuring assets remain current and accessible.
  • Onboarding, Scope & Readiness Support: Coordinate system access, environment provisioning, and onboarding logistics for new onshore and offshore team members. Support scope change documentation by tracking scope decisions against the program plan and budget. Track go/no-go checklist items and ensure owner accountability ahead of cutover.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5–8 years of project management experience, with at least 3 years spent on enterprise software delivery engagements.
  • Demonstrable experience running hybrid onshore/offshore delivery teams across multiple time zones.
  • Strong proficiency with Jira, sprint management, backlog grooming, reporting, and dashboard configuration.
  • Proven experience managing risk and issue logs, program plans, and delivery governance on multi-workstream programs.
  • Solid understanding of agile delivery methodologies, sprint ceremonies, velocity tracking, and iterative delivery cadences.
  • Experience contributing to client-facing status reports and stakeholder communications.
  • Experience coordinating with third-party technology implementation teams on project dependencies and integration touchpoints.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to assist with documentation drafting, status reporting, meeting summarization, and program tracking (AI-assisted productivity is standard practice on this engagement).
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to draft clear, concise status reports and communicate delivery status effectively to both internal and client stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills and extreme attention to detail, with a proven ability to track multiple concurrent workstreams seamlessly.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with bi-weekly sprint cycles and frequent stakeholder touchpoints.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent formal project management certification.
  • Prior experience delivering ERP modernization, cloud platform, or enterprise data programs.
  • Experience supporting production cutover planning and go/no-go readiness coordination.
  • Prior consulting or professional services delivery experience.

jobs.title: Legal Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Contract: Full-time, Independent Contractor

Location: Remote — we hire across multiple jurisdictions

Hours: US Eastern Time

Our Firm

Sterlington PLLC is a full-service law firm focusing on complex corporate, litigation, executive compensation, and private wealth matters. As a firm, we focus on the economic as well as the legal aspects of our matters. Among other strengths, Sterlington is the ultimate law firm for founders, senior executives, and UHNWIs as well as their related businesses.

We are remote-first, and our support teams work as one global Legal Operations function across multiple time zones.

Learn more at www.sterlingtonlaw.com

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Legal Project Manager to sit at the center of how Legal Operations runs — coordinating the matter lifecycle end to end, onboarding incoming partners and their teams, and acting as the single accountable point of contact between Legal Operations and the rest of the business.

You will also own the data and knowledge backbone of the function — turning capacity, matter, and referral data into reporting the firm can act on. We are looking for someone who is naturally organized, comfortable operating across functions without formal authority over any of them, and who treats “who owns this next step” as a question that always has an answer.

What You’ll Do

  • The matter lifecycle, end to end. Opening, staffing, key milestones, status reporting and closing. Records that are accurate and current because you keep them that way, not because someone audits them. Sign-offs, approvals and closing checklists chased to completion rather than reported as outstanding.
  • Partner onboarding. Every workstream for an incoming partner and their team: systems access, conflicts, files, billing setup. Tracked to done. A partner joining Sterlington should experience this as one coordinated process, not as five functions contacting them separately.
  • The cross-functional interface. Routing requests to the right owner, translating between functions, and keeping initiatives moving without executing the specialist work yourself. You need enough literacy in Finance, BD and IT to speak each language credibly. You do not need to do any of their jobs.
  • AI-assisted workflow design. Sterlington is building toward a fully AI-augmented practice. In this role that means designing and running the AI-assisted workflows that sit around the matter lifecycle, and holding the line between what AI produces and what a lawyer reviews. This is not a support expectation bolted onto the role. It is one of the reasons the role exists.
  • The function’s operating data. Keeping matter and capacity data clean enough to be trusted, maintaining the reporting the firm already relies on, and flagging the patterns you can see in it: pressure points, referral opportunities, and where capacity is about to break. Building the firm’s full analytics and knowledge management capability is not in scope for this role, and we will say so plainly rather than write it into a job description and hope.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in project coordination, ideally within a law firm, professional services, or Legal Operations environment
  • Working literacy in the matter lifecycle — how matters open, staff, progress, and close — even if you haven’t run one yourself
  • Strong stakeholder management skills; comfortable being the point of contact between a specialist function and the rest of the business
  • Enough functional literacy in Finance, Business Development/Marketing, and IT to coordinate effectively with each — you don’t need to do their jobs, but you need to speak their language
  • Strong written communication; able to translate between functions clearly and without losing nuance
  • Comfort with data and dashboards — capacity analytics, cross-referencing, and pattern recognition across matters
  • Experience with practice management, billing, or knowledge management systems, or evidence you’ve learned a comparable system quickly
  • Excellent organizational skills; able to track multiple workstreams and sign-off chains without dropping detail
  • Non-negotiable: ownership — the instinct to chase an open item to completion rather than wait for someone else to close it
  • Comfortable working to defined service standards and deadlines in a remote, cross-time-zone environment

At Sterlington, we believe that world-class talent has no boundaries. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where unique perspectives are valued and every individual has the opportunity to thrive. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

jobs.title: Senior, Product Manager - Autonomy Scaling
jobs.jd_full:
About the Company

At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business. A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight. Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

Meet the Team

This team is looking for someone with combined technical and product management experience to define and drive the next generation of on-road autonomous driving technology, meeting customer needs as effectively and efficiently as possible. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to define the capabilities and features that will unlock autonomous driving, deliver actionable product definitions and roadmaps to achieve product milestones, integrate plans with organizational leaders, gather feedback from customers and stakeholders, and maintain a backlog that balances customer requirements with technological feasibility and company objectives. You’ll own the product definition, scope, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration needed to enable the product development plan for your area, and serve as a subject matter expert. In the near term, this role will specialize in Mapping, defining the maps and localization data our automated trucks rely on, with room to grow into other Virtual Driver domains such as ODD quantification and simulation as the team’s needs evolve. You’ll work closely with potential customers, engineering, technical partners, strategy, marketing, and sales to ensure the product meets the needs of Torc and future customers.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive the product vision internally by developing high-quality product definition, scoping, and prioritization, with an initial focus on Mapping (map data, coverage, freshness, and quality) and the flexibility to extend into other Virtual Driver domains over time.
  • Drive the development of product features and functionality by liaising between the engineering team and relevant stakeholders. Gather user requirements, build product requirements, and communicate with engineering and other stakeholders at all levels of planning and execution.
